new.quote: DIANE: Security, arrest thirty-two-year-old nurse Harper for stealing our most priceless family heirloom from the study!

prior.quote: Jake Whitmore, 29, physically corners 24-year-old nurse Harper Lane outside the ambulance bay doors.
HARPER: You lied to a broke 24-year-old night-shift nurse just to use me for a contract marriage, Cole!
JAKE: He lied to you, twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse Harper, he is no poor mechanic named Cole Hayes!

flags.explanation: Diane calls Harper thirty-two years old here, directly contradicting her established age of twenty-four.
flags.verify_reason: Diane refers to Harper as a thirty-two-year-old nurse, which directly and irreconcilably contradicts her established age of twenty-four across multiple prior episodes without any textual support for a time skip, disguise, or lie within the provided lines.
